notes.title: Minor Update: Bug Fixes and Translation Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, players!

To provide you with the best gaming experience, we've implemented a minor update. This update focuses on fixing bugs and improving translations in the game.

We're always listening to your feedback and working hard to create an even better environment. Enjoy the game!

Thank you.
